states.EXACT_HIGH_CONFIDENCE: Compatible normalized name, collector number, set/approved alias, language, raw state, and every material variant dimension; no exclusion evidence.
states.EXACT_MEDIUM_CONFIDENCE: Name and collector number compatible but one non-catastrophic set or variant signal is missing.
states.AMBIGUOUS: Competing canonical or market-variant interpretations remain.
states.REJECTED: Wrong identity, language, graded state, bundle/lot, sealed/accessory, proxy, or ineligible condition.

activationGate: Independent frozen benchmark precision >=99% and Wilson 95% lower bound >=98%.
